items: Two teenagers who meet at a cancer support group fall in love and set out to find the reclusive author of their favorite novel.
The placeholder volume from the original Java console version of this library, kept on the shelf for old times' sake.
Seven generations of the Buendía family rise and fall in the town of Macondo, where the miraculous is treated as ordinary.
In post-Civil War Ohio, a woman who escaped slavery is haunted by the daughter she lost, who seems to return in human form.
Winston Smith rewrites history for a state that watches everyone, and risks everything on a forbidden love affair.
On the desert planet Arrakis, young Paul Atreides is caught in a struggle over the most valuable substance in the universe.
An envoy to the icy planet Gethen, whose people have no fixed sex, has to learn trust across a deep cultural divide.
Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy badly misjudge each other before slowly finding their way past pride and first impressions.
Okonkwo, a proud Igbo leader, watches his world come apart as colonial rule and missionaries arrive in his village.
Esperanza Cordero grows up in a Latino neighborhood in Chicago, told in short, poetic vignettes.
A Black writer in 1976 Los Angeles is pulled back in time, again and again, to a plantation in antebellum Maryland.
Victor Frankenstein builds a living being and then abandons it, with tragic results for both of them.
A Franciscan friar investigates a string of deaths in a 14th-century abbey whose forbidden library sits at the heart of the mystery.
A burned-out hacker is hired for one last job in a future soaked in cyberspace. A founding novel of cyberpunk.
Juan Preciado travels to the village of Comala to find his father and finds a town full of whispering ghosts.
Esther Greenwood's summer internship in New York gives way to a deepening depression, in Plath's only novel.
In Neo-Tokyo, decades after a devastating war, a teenage biker gang member gains terrifying psychic powers.
Major Motoko Kusanagi leads a cybercrime unit in a future where bodies are machines and minds can be hacked.
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
A princess tries to make peace between warring kingdoms and a spreading toxic forest full of giant insects.
Guts, a lone mercenary with an enormous sword, fights his way through a dark medieval world shaped by betrayal and demons.
A Japanese surgeon in Germany saves a young boy's life, then learns years later that the boy has grown into a killer.
A fictionalized retelling of the life of the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi.
A small coastal town is slowly consumed by an obsession with spirals. Horror at its strangest.
A student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, and a brilliant detective sets out to stop him.
In an alternate 1985, retired costumed heroes are pulled back together by the murder of one of their own.
Spiegelman records his father's memories of surviving the Holocaust, drawing Jews as mice and Nazis as cats.
Marjane Satrapi's memoir of growing up in Iran during and after the Islamic Revolution.
Dream of the Endless escapes decades of captivity and sets out to rebuild his ruined realm.
An aging Bruce Wayne comes out of retirement to face a Gotham City overrun by crime.
Two soldiers from opposite sides of an endless war fall in love and go on the run with their newborn daughter.
A demon raised by humans investigates the paranormal, and the mystery of where he came from.
The long-running series by Los Bros Hernandez; Jaime's stories follow Maggie and Hopey through the Southern California punk scene.
The last album the Beatles recorded together, closing with a long medley across side two.
Pink Floyd's concept album about time, money, pressure and madness.
Miles Davis's modal jazz landmark, recorded with John Coltrane and Bill Evans.
Written while the band's relationships were falling apart, and somehow full of hits.
A song cycle about war, poverty and the planet, told through the eyes of a returning veteran.
Joni Mitchell's intimate, confessional album of songs about love and travel.
Joy Division's debut: stark, cold, atmospheric post-punk.
Prince and The Revolution's soundtrack to the film of the same name.
Radiohead's album about technology, alienation and modern life.
Lauryn Hill's solo debut, blending hip hop, soul and reggae.
The Cure's lush, slow, melancholy masterpiece.
Veteran Cuban musicians recorded in Havana, bringing son and bolero to listeners around the world.
Santana's second album, fusing rock guitar with Latin percussion.
Strings and electronic beats inspired by the landscapes of Iceland.
Nas's debut, a vivid portrait of life in Queensbridge, Queens.
Sonic Youth's sprawling double album of noise rock.
A thief who steals secrets from people's dreams is hired to plant an idea instead.
A hacker learns the world he knows is a simulation and joins the fight against the machines that run it.
A girl trapped in a world of spirits takes a job at a bathhouse to save her parents.
In 1944 Spain, a girl escapes into a dark fairy-tale world while her stepfather hunts rebels in the hills.
A detective in a rain-soaked future Los Angeles hunts down escaped artificial humans.
A shy Parisian waitress secretly sets out to improve the lives of the people around her.
A struggling family schemes its way into working for a wealthy household, until everything spirals.
A nightclub owner in wartime Morocco must choose between his old love and helping her escape.
A year in the life of a live-in housekeeper for a middle-class family in 1970s Mexico City.
In a towering future city split between the rich and the workers below, a young man takes the workers' side.
Two neighbors in 1962 Hong Kong discover their spouses are having an affair, and slowly grow close.
Three chapters in the life of a young Black man growing up in Miami.
A farming village hires seven samurai to defend it from bandits.
A writer takes a winter job as caretaker of an isolated mountain hotel, with his wife and son.
A young photographer grows up amid gang wars in a Rio de Janeiro favela.
The crew of a space freighter answers a distress call and brings back something deadly.
